blocks.text: Dawaiyan (pharmaceutical products) banane mein chirality aik bohat ahem khoobi hai jo dawa ki hifazat (safety) aur asar (efficacy) tay karti hai. Jaandaar jism (biological system) chiral ajza (building blocks) se bana hai, aur dawa ke receptors bohat makhsoos “chiral taalon” (chiral locks) ki tarah kaam karte hain: sirf sahi shakal wali “chaabi” fit hoti hai. Is liye chiral dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar aksar bohat mukhtalif hota hai.

blocks.alt: Thalidomide: benzene ka halqa (andar daira) aik paanch atom wale halqe se jura jis mein do C=O groups aur aik N hai. Yeh N dashed bond se aik chhe atom wale halqe ke carbon se jura hai jis mein bhi do C=O groups aur aik N-H hai; is carbon par thos wedge par H hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.7: Thalidomide (kitab ki Figure 19.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dashed bond ke daen sire wala ring carbon chiral hai: is par H, N aur ring ke do mukhtalif carbon (aik C=O ki taraf, aik CH₂ ki taraf) jure hain. Is liye thalidomide ke do enantiomers hain. Dawa racemic mixture ki shakal mein bechi gayi thi, aur jism mein khalis (+) isomer bhi jaldi racemic ho jata hai.

Thalidomide aik tranquilliser (sukoon dene wali dawa) thi jo shuru mein racemic mixture ki shakal mein bechi gayi (Figure 19.7). Yeh bohat kamyab aur ghair zehreeli (non-toxic) sedative lagti thi jis ke koi side-effects maloom na the. Lekin 1960 ki dahai ke shuru mein pata chala ke jin auraton ne hamal (pregnancy) ke shuru ke dinon mein matli (nausea, “morning sickness”) ke liye yeh dawa li thi, un ke bachche shadeed jismani naqais (deformities) ke saath paida hue. Dawa foran market se wapas le li gayi.

Tehqeeq (research) se pata chala ke (+) isomer asar wala aur mehfooz tranquilliser tha, jab ke (−) isomer pet mein bachche (fetus) ko nuqsan pohanchata tha. Pehle samjha gaya ke kuch batches mein (−) isomer ki milawat (contamination) masla thi, lekin baad ki tehqeeq ne dikhaya ke khalis (+) isomer khoon mein jate hi tezi se racemise ho jata hai (yani (+) aur (−) ka mixture ban jata hai): 10 minute mein racemisation 50% se zyada mukammal ho jati hai. Thalidomide ke aise milte julte compounds (analogues) jin ki chirality stable rehti hai, sozish (inflammation) ki dawa ke taur par parkhe ja rahe hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke thalidomide dobara kabhi market nahi hogi. Darasal thalidomide baad mein sakht pabandiyon ke saath, jo hamal mein is ka istemal rokti hain, dobara manzoor hui: USA mein 1998 mein leprosy ki aik pecheedgi ke liye aur 2006 mein khoon ke cancer multiple myeloma ke liye.

blocks.prompt: Thalidomide ka sirf mehfooz (+) isomer bechna kyun kaafi nahi tha?
blocks.explanation: (+) isomer khoon mein bohat jaldi racemise ho jata hai (10 minute mein 50% se zyada), is liye nuqsan wala (−) isomer jism mein phir bhi ban jata hai.

items: Receptors chiral hain, is liye dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar bohat mukhtalif ho sakta hai.
Isi liye racemic mixtures ko alag karna parta hai, ya chiral catalysts se sirf aik khalis optical isomer banaya jata hai.
Thalidomide: (−) isomer ne pet ke bachche ko nuqsan diya; (+) isomer jism mein racemise ho jata hai.
